outlets.name: Disney Tourist Blog (Tom Bricker)
outlets.credible: One of the largest independent Disney planning blogs since 2010 (Tom & Sarah Bricker); detailed first-hand restaurant reviews and annual top-10 dining rankings

outlets.credible: Brevard County's official tourism office; curated dining guides (like VISITORLANDO)

outlets.name: Distinguished Restaurants of North America (DiRoNA)
outlets.credible: Long-running North American fine-dining award program with anonymous inspections; Award of Excellence

outlets.name: Florida Restaurant & Lodging Association
outlets.credible: Statewide restaurant trade association; reported Emeril Lagasse's Emeril's Florida TV features

outlets.name: West Orange Times & Observer (Orange Observer)
outlets.credible: Weekly community newspaper of record for Winter Garden, Windermere and Ocoee (Observer Media Group)

outlets.name: Florida Hikes! (Sandra Friend & John Keatley)
outlets.credible: Run by Sandra Friend, author of 30+ Florida hiking guidebooks and Florida Trail Association mainstay; first-hand trail reports
